names.reason: The deciding line is the Q4/FY core guide against a consensus already at the top of the range ($273m Q4, about $890m FY), and it depends on capacity timing that I cannot see in the public record. It does not net to a direction the price lacks, and the option skew already pays for upside.

A FY guide held at $880-890m after a Q3 beat (implied Q4 cut), or any mention of data-center delivery slippage, would make it a down print.
